title: Tech Trends 2018: The symphonic enterprise
notes: 7 trend chapters plus 'Exponential technology watch list' (entries 8-9). Each trend chapter states its own 18-to-24-month horizon. The exponentials chapter places exponentials in 'a “horizon 3 to 5” timeframe—between 36 and 60 months' and says AGI and quantum encryption 'fall into the 5+ category'. A per-region 'Timeliness' chart (Now to 5+ years) appears in the report; chart values are not stored. Published month not stated in the PDF.

entries.label: Reengineering technology
entries.quote: That’s about to change: Over the next 18 to 24 months, we will likely see CIOs begin reengineering not only their IT shops but, more broadly, their approaches to technology.
entries.subject: IT operating model transformation

entries.label: No-collar workforce
entries.quote: During the next 18 to 24 months, expect more companies to embrace the emerging no-collar workforce trend by redesigning jobs and reimagining how work gets done in a hybrid human-and-machine environment.
entries.subject: Human-machine workforce (automation, AI)

entries.label: Enterprise data sovereignty
entries.quote: We expect that, in the next 18 to 24 months, more companies will begin modernizing their approaches to data management, working to strike the right balance between control and accessibility.
entries.subject: Enterprise data management and governance

entries.label: The new core
entries.quote: Expect this to change over the course of the next 18 to 24 months as CIOs, CFOs, and supply chain leaders begin developing new digital capabilities in their core systems.
entries.subject: Digital core systems (finance, supply chain)

entries.label: Digital reality
entries.quote: During the next 18 to 24 months, the digital reality trend will likely gain momentum as more companies pilot use cases and accelerate into production.
entries.subject: Digital reality (AR, VR, mixed reality)

entries.label: Blockchain to blockchains
entries.quote: In the latest blockchain trend that will unfold over the next 18 to 24 months, expect to see more organizations push beyond these obstacles and turn initial use cases and PoCs into fully deployed production solutions.
entries.subject: Blockchain

entries.label: API imperative
entries.quote: Over the next 18 to 24 months, expect many heretofore cautious companies to embrace the API imperative—the strategic deployment of application programming interfaces
entries.subject: APIs and the API economy
entries.note: A page header and page number interrupt this sentence in the PDF text, so an automatic check does not match it; verified by reading.

entries.label: Artificial general intelligence
entries.quote: For example, artificial general intelligence (AGI) and quantum encryption, which we examine later in this chapter, fall into the 5+ category.
entries.subject: Artificial general intelligence

entries.label: Quantum encryption
entries.quote: For example, artificial general intelligence (AGI) and quantum encryption, which we examine later in this chapter, fall into the 5+ category.
entries.subject: Quantum encryption (quantum-safe cryptography)
entries.note: Quote shared with the AGI entry; the chapter treats both together.
